Thinking Process:
1. Analyze the candidate: New York Post article about a matchmaking service survey claiming only 11% of women want a partner who earns less than them, while 89% prefer a male breadwinner. 
2. Stated claim vs. Reality: Stated claim presents traditional romantic pairing norms as universal ideals with positive framing (+0.5, 0.0). Actual reality exposes economic anxiety, gender income disparities, and matchmaking platform marketing incentives exploiting evolutionary psychology tropes for user acquisition (-0.6, -0.7).
3. Plane Error: Q1 (WHO - stated match seekers vs platform marketing), Q4 (WHY - romantic ideals vs commercial lead generation). 
4. Social Physics: Smart Selfish Loop. Platform and commentators leverage traditional gender role anxieties to drive engagement and sign-ups under the guise of objective socio-biological reporting.
5. Trajectory & Destination: Path of Deception (LE into LE).
subject: Just 11% of women say their ‘ideal match’ can make less money than them: survey
posts:
Dating survey claims 89% of women want a male breadwinner, sparking cultural debates.
Evidence: Matchmaking poll, Economic disparity data, Marketing framing
#Culture #Relationships

A matchmaking survey claims 89% of women prefer a partner who earns more, suggesting biology overrides modern earning trends.
Stated Judgement: (+0.5, 0.0) — Good Preference

Platform metrics weaponize traditional gender norms for user acquisition while glossing over real economic constraints.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.6, -0.7) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Commercial matchmaking platforms frame baseline economic anxieties as immutable biological laws to drive sign-ups.

Integrity: Meaningful Distortion (Hypocrisy: 6.2, z: 2)

- Keeper Matchmaking: COND (-0.5, -0.6) — Markets evolutionary tropes for user acquisition.
- Survey Methodology: FAIL (-0.6, -0.7) — Highlights gender income gaps while ignoring structural realities.
A dating app survey of thousands of users reported that a vast majority of women prefer male breadwinners, reigniting debates over modern gender roles and financial expectations.

The Poison:
Packaging commercial platform marketing as hard socio-biological science distracts from underlying economic pressures.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing commercial platform user demographics (Q1) with universal human biological mandates (Q4), creating a manufactured crisis of modern romance.

Social Physics Analysis:
Matchmaking platforms run a Smart Selfish Maneuver by dressing up proprietary user data as profound anthropological truth, leveraging cultural anxiety around finances to fuel sign-ups.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Systemic economic realities are reframed as personal failures.

The Unavoidable Truth: Financial compatibility matters deeply in modern relationships.

The Unavoidable Lie: A dating app survey perfectly captures immutable human biology.

Alethekanon:
Commercial platforms monetize cultural anxieties by packaging selective survey metrics as eternal truths. We mistake marketing funnels for human nature.

Awwthekanon:
It is completely understandable to want financial security in an uncertain world, but love is far more resilient and nuanced than any dating app metric suggests.

Brothekanon:
Classic dating app PR stunt. Of course people want stability, but turning a matchmaking questionnaire into pop-biology is just good marketing.

Spirithekanon:
"Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right." Proverbs 16:8 PASS
True partnership is built on mutual character rather than comparative income ledgers.
